notes.title: Alchemy of the Earth Patch 1.1 is live
notes.notes:
[p][b]\[Alchemy of the Earth Patch 1.1 is out!][/b] [/p][list][*][p]Many UI fixes & menu improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Completely revamped graphics menu using Common UI as its foundation[/p][/*][*][p]Fully remappable controller support[/p][/*][*][p]Sound cue and subtitle fixes for main narration[/p][/*][*][p]Many world fixes and optimizations in the denser areas of the map[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies will now properly cull when hidden from the player \[Thank you for your optimizer component ToasterMuffin!]
[/p][/*][/list][p]Common UI integration for Alchemy of the Earth was done by Niko Heino, thank you Niko!

We'll make periodic fixes and improvements to the game as we go, please do continue to provide me feedback and bug reports, I appreciate all the help and support I've received thusfar. 
[/p][p]Christopher Pearson
Tamalpais Games[/p]

notes.title: Alchemy of the Earth is live on Steam
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44851403/4a57845cd77f22840f39e9a59dffcf51b8bda9ad.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]\[Alchemy of the Earth is out now on Steam!][/b]
Thank you to everyone who has wishlisted, followed, and/or playtested Alchemy of the Earth. This is going to be a short announcement, because I'm very tired & its 5:45AM on Aug 13, 2025, but in the last few months I've been completely blown away by all the interest I've gotten for this little solo project. As of right now Alchemy of the Earth has been Wishlisted [b]9,494[/b] times, followed [b]914[/b] times & the demo has been played [b]865[/b] times. Watching people play the demo has been incredibly helpful for me, in better understanding how to make a functional, fun to play game. This is my first ever game, but I'm not done with it. The work continues.
[/p][p]Take care, young alchemists, [/p][p]Christopher Pearson
Tamalpais Games[/p]

notes.title: Alchemy of the Earth Demo v1.0.1 live now
notes.notes:
[p]Alchemy of the Earth Demo v1.0.1 is now live!
[/p][p][b]Fixes & Improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed game freezes related to some old goat blueprints. If anyone gets a game freeze near a goat please let me know where it happened. [/p][/*][*][p]Improved performance in a few heavy areas.[/p][/*][*][p]The escape key now exits crafting menus.[/p][/*][*][p]Sunflowers should now be easier to harvest.[/p][/*][*][p]Audio areas now start properly when the player spawns within their overlap volume.[/p][/*][*][p]Autosave should now only trigger if the player is alive.[/p][/*][*][p]New sound effects for skeletons and skeleton mage spells are implemented.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated level instances near starting area to improve performance.[/p][/*][*][p]Added windowed fullscreen settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a few variants of the Light spell, called "Blast" and "Beam" these each cost more mana than Light and do more damage. (Yes, Light causes damage! Use it!!)[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks to everyone who has been playtesting and providing feedback. Please keep sharing your thoughts with me and stay tuned for more updates.[/p][p][/p][p]-Chris[/p]
